$comment: Shared palette and mood for the whole Place. Authored by hand while the object count is small; docs/style-guide.json is the path the style-colorist agent reads and writes. Object code imports this, so hand-built objects cannot drift - the agent's audit mode is for generated objects, which arrive with their colours already baked in.

materials.note: Everything outdoors is fully rough. Nothing in this Place is polished; the only shine arrives with wet weather in phase 5.

objects.$comment: Registry of generated objects and any palette corrections applied to them, so drift is tracked over time. Empty while every object is hand-built from the palette above.
